The Authentic Name

Why cháos.com is the correct form

Greek Original

Χάος

The name in its original Greek form. A name that carries the full phonetic weight of its source tradition.

ASCII Constraint

CHAOS

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

Cháos

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
cháos.com → xn--chos-6na.com

The non-ASCII characters in Cháos are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is Cháos.

Tier Classification

Why Cháos is classified as Tier-2 Accent-Preserving

The Greek original Χάος contains only stress (acute accent). This makes it a single-tier Tier-2 name. The Unicode restoration preserves what can be preserved — honoring the single feature that distinguishes it from plain ASCII.
